description: This file defines an interface and its implementation for providing broadcast channels in Orleans. It includes classes for the provider and methods to get channel writers, as well as a static method for creating instances using dependency injection.

classes.name: IBroadcastChannelProvider
classes.description: Interface defining methods to access broadcast channels and get channel writers.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelProvider
classes.description: Internal implementation of IBroadcastChannelProvider that manages broadcast channel writers, with a factory method for creation.

methods.name: GetChannelWriter
methods.description: Returns a broadcast channel writer for the specified channel ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate BroadcastChannelProvider via dependency injection.
